NONE: A1 a title used before the family name or full name of a married woman who has no other title
（用在已婚婦女的姓或姓名之前）夫人，太太
› used when expressing the idea that a woman is typical of or represents a quality, activity, or place
（用以表示某已婚女士是某一品質、活動或地方的典型代表）

example: [ as form of address ] Hello, Mrs Grant, how are you today?
你好，葛蘭夫人，你今天怎麼樣？
Mrs Average (= a woman who is typical of an ordinary woman)
